diagnosis: When users run analytical reports, DuckDB copies query results to parquet export files on disk. This endpoint downloads completed export files by export_job_id. It authenticates current_user but omits checking whether job.tenant_id matches current_user.tenant_id, allowing users to download completed analytical reports generated by other companies.
exploit_request:
GET /analytics/exports/exp_job_99812_tax_report/download HTTP/1.1
Host: bi-lakehouse.internal-cloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
